# t_funcs.sech { #clerq.t_funcs.sech }

```python
t_funcs.sech(index)
```

Return a sech pulse time function.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                        |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``centre_{index}``, either         |
|        | TFunc  | ``ampl_{index}`` or ``n_pi_{index}``, and either ``width_{index}`` |
|        | TFunc  | or ``fwhm_{index}`` from args. Raises ``KeyError`` if conflicting  |
|        | TFunc  | or missing parameters are found.                                   |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- The amplitude can be set directly via ``ampl_{index}`` or
  indirectly via ``n_pi_{index}`` (desired pulse area in multiples
  of π).
- The width can be set directly via ``width_{index}`` or indirectly
  via ``fwhm_{index}`` (full-width at half maximum).
